source.text: The Story of Sin is a 1975 Polish drama film directed by Walerian Borowczyk based on the novel" Dzieje grzechu" by Stefan Żeromski. It was entered into the 1975 Cannes Film Festival.

source.text: Walerian Borowczyk( 21 October 1923 – 3 February 2006) was an internationally known Polish film director described by film critics as a' genius who also happened to be a pornographer'. He directed 40 films between 1946 and 1988. Borowczyk settled in Paris in 1959. As a film director he worked mainly in France.
source.title: Walerian Borowczyk
